# Reuse shared instrumented dependencies across different workflow programs.
# Host-only code and private layouts must keep different cache identities.
[short] skip
go build -debug-actiongraph=ordinary.json -o ordinary.exe ./ordinary
exec ./ordinary.exe
stdout 'ordinary state passed'
go build -debug-actiongraph=a.json -o a.exe ./hosta
exec ./a.exe
stdout 'private state passed'
go build -debug-actiongraph=b.json -o b.exe ./hostb
exec ./b.exe
stdout 'private state passed'
go run ./inspect ordinary.json a.json b.json
stdout 'shared dependencies reused; ownership layouts separated'

# An empty state selection still enforces isolate privilege checks.
! go build -o badguard.exe -gcflags=example.com/isolate-cache/badguard=-d=isolatebuild=1 ./badguard
stderr 'isolate: source cannot link to privileged operation runtime.isolateEnterMetadata'

-- go.mod --
module example.com/isolate-cache
go 1.26
-- leaf/leaf.go --
package leaf
var Count = 7
func Next() int { Count++; return Count }
-- shared/shared.go --
package shared
import "example.com/isolate-cache/leaf"
func Next() int { return leaf.Next() }
-- a/a.go --
package a
import "example.com/isolate-cache/shared"
//temporal:workflow
func Entry() (int,error) { return shared.Next(),nil }
-- b/b.go --
package b
import "example.com/isolate-cache/shared"
//temporal:workflow
func Entry() (int,error) { return shared.Next(),nil }
-- hosta/main.go --
package main
import (
 "example.com/isolate-cache/a"
 "example.com/isolate-cache/host"
)
func main() { host.Run(a.Entry) }
-- hostb/main.go --
package main
import (
 "example.com/isolate-cache/b"
 "example.com/isolate-cache/host"
)
func main() { host.Run(b.Entry) }
-- host/host.go --
package host
import (
 "fmt"
 "isolate"
 "example.com/isolate-cache/leaf"
)
func Run(fn any) {
 h,ok:=isolate.LookupFunction(fn); if !ok {panic("entry missing")}
 for range 2 {
  i,err:=isolate.New(isolate.Config{Program:h.ProgramWithHandle(dispatch)}); if err!=nil {panic(err)}
  if err=i.Start();err!=nil {panic(err)}
  c:=<-i.Commands(); if len(c.Payload)!=1 || c.Payload[0]!=8 {panic("private state leaked")}
  c.Reply(nil,nil)
  if err=i.Wait();err!=nil {panic(err)}
 }
 if leaf.Count!=7 {panic("host state changed")}
 fmt.Println("private state passed")
}
func dispatch(h isolate.Handle) {
 err:=h.Invoke(func(...isolate.Value)error{return nil},func(v ...isolate.Value)error {
  _,err:=isolate.Call(1,[]byte{byte(v[0].Value.(int))}); return err
 })
 if err!=nil {panic(err)}
}
-- ordinary/main.go --
package main
import (
 "fmt"
 "example.com/isolate-cache/shared"
)
func main() {
 if shared.Next()!=8 || shared.Next()!=9 {panic("ordinary state")}
 fmt.Println("ordinary state passed")
}
-- inspect/main.go --
package main
import (
 "encoding/json"
 "fmt"
 "os"
)
type action struct { Mode,Package,ActionID string; Cmd []string }
func read(path string) map[string]action {
 data,err:=os.ReadFile(path); if err!=nil {panic(err)}
 var actions []action; if err=json.Unmarshal(data,&actions);err!=nil {panic(err)}
 result:=map[string]action{}
 for _,a:=range actions {if a.Mode=="build-export" {result[a.Package]=a}}
 return result
}
func main() {
 ordinary,a,b:=read(os.Args[1]),read(os.Args[2]),read(os.Args[3])
 for _,pkg:=range []string{"runtime","fmt","example.com/isolate-cache/shared","example.com/isolate-cache/leaf"} {
  first,ok:=a[pkg]; if !ok || first.ActionID=="" {panic("first action missing: "+pkg)}
  next,ok:=b[pkg]; if !ok || next.ActionID!=first.ActionID || len(next.Cmd)!=0 {panic("dependency rebuilt: "+pkg)}
  if ordinary[pkg].ActionID==first.ActionID {panic("ownership modes shared a cache entry: "+pkg)}
 }
 fmt.Println("shared dependencies reused; ownership layouts separated")
}
-- badguard/main.go --
package main
import _ "unsafe"
//go:linkname enter runtime.isolateEnterMetadata
func enter()
func main() {enter()}
